name: Southeast Cement Corporation
summary: Southeast Cement Corporation specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of cement products across Taiwan. Its diverse product line encompasses Portland I and Portland II cement, hearthstone, kiln stone powder, various processed cement goods, and premixed concrete. The company also extends its activities to include investment ventures and environmental waste management services. Moreover, it engages in the real estate sector, handling the development, leasing, and sales of both residential and commercial properties. Established in 1956, the firm is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
